"""Tests for handling Unicode characters with display width != character count.

This addresses the issue where columns don't align when cells contain
Japanese or other wide characters. The terminal displays Japanese characters
with width 2, but Python's len() counts them as width 1.
"""

import pytest
from tablefmt import render


class TestJapaneseBasic:
    """Basic rendering with Japanese characters."""

    def test_simple_japanese_cell(self):
        """A single Japanese cell should not break alignment."""
        result = render([["レポート", "12"]], ["name", "KB"])
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Should have 3 lines: header, separator, data
        assert len(lines) == 3
        # All lines should have same number of display-visible pipes
        assert lines[0].count("|") == 1
        assert lines[1].count("|") == 1
        assert lines[2].count("|") == 1

    def test_japanese_and_ascii_rows(self):
        """Mixed Japanese and ASCII rows should align properly."""
        rows = [["レポート_2024.pdf", "12"], ["notes.txt", "3"]]
        result = render(rows, ["name", "KB"])
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Header, separator, two data rows
        assert len(lines) == 4
        # Extract column widths from the separator line
        separator = lines[1]
        # The separator should use proper widths for alignment
        pipes = [i for i, c in enumerate(separator) if c == "+"]
        assert len(pipes) >= 1  # At least one pipe between columns

    def test_multiple_japanese_cells(self):
        """Multiple cells with Japanese text should all align."""
        rows = [
            ["レポート", "議事録"],
            ["notes.txt", "records.txt"],
        ]
        result = render(rows, ["file1", "file2"])
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # All content lines should have the same number of separators
        for line in lines[2:]:  # Skip header and separator
            assert line.count("|") == lines[2].count("|")

    def test_japanese_in_header(self):
        """Japanese characters in headers should be handled correctly."""
        result = render([["foo", "bar"]], ["名前", "KB"])
        lines = result.split("\n")
        assert len(lines) == 3
        # Header and data should both have same number of columns
        assert lines[0].count("|") == lines[2].count("|")


class TestJapaneseAlignment:
    """Test alignment with Japanese characters."""

    def test_left_align_japanese(self):
        """Left alignment should work with Japanese text."""
        result = render([["レポート"]], align="left")
        # Should have no separators to cause issues
        assert isinstance(result, str)
        assert "レポート" in result

    def test_right_align_japanese(self):
        """Right alignment should pad correctly with Japanese text."""
        result = render([["レポート", "x"]], align="right")
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Both columns should exist
        assert "|" in lines[0]

    def test_center_align_japanese(self):
        """Center alignment should work with Japanese text."""
        result = render([["レポート", "x"]], align="center")
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Both columns should exist
        assert "|" in lines[0]

    def test_mixed_alignment_with_japanese(self):
        """Different alignments per column with Japanese text."""
        rows = [["レポート", "12"], ["notes", "345"]]
        result = render(rows, align=["left", "right"])
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Both rows should have same structure
        assert lines[2].count("|") == lines[3].count("|")


class TestJapaneseTruncation:
    """Test max_width with Japanese characters."""

    def test_truncate_before_japanese(self):
        """Truncation that ends before Japanese characters."""
        result = render([["abcレポート"]], max_width=4)
        # Should truncate to fit within display width
        assert "…" in result
        assert len(result.split("\n")[0]) > 0

    def test_truncate_mid_japanese_name(self):
        """Truncation with Japanese in filename should produce ellipsis."""
        result = render([["レポート_2024.pdf"]], max_width=10)
        # Should have been truncated
        assert "…" in result

    def test_truncate_all_japanese(self):
        """Truncating Japanese text should work."""
        result = render([["議事録"]], max_width=4)
        # 議事録 = 3 chars × 2 width = 6 display width
        # max_width=4 means truncate
        assert "…" in result

    def test_truncate_mixed_text(self):
        """Truncation with mixed ASCII and Japanese."""
        result = render([["file_レポート_2024.pdf"]], max_width=12)
        # Should truncate the Japanese-containing name
        assert "…" in result or len(result.split("\n")[0]) <= 15


class TestJapaneseWrapping:
    """Test wrap=True with Japanese characters."""

    def test_wrap_long_japanese(self):
        """Long Japanese text with wrap=True should break correctly."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート議事録のまとめ"]],
            max_width=8,
            wrap=True
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Should wrap into multiple lines
        assert len(lines) > 1

    def test_wrap_mixed_japanese_ascii(self):
        """Wrapping mixed Japanese and ASCII text."""
        result = render(
            [["report_レポート_summary"]],
            max_width=10,
            wrap=True
        )
        # Should have wrapped
        assert "\n" in result

    def test_wrap_preserves_alignment(self):
        """Wrapped Japanese text should not break column alignment."""
        rows = [
            ["レポート議事録", "data"],
            ["x", "y"],
        ]
        result = render(rows, max_width=8, wrap=True)
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Both rows should have same number of pipe separators
        # (even though first row spans multiple lines)
        for line in lines:
            if line.strip():  # Non-empty lines
                assert "|" in line or line.startswith(" ")


class TestRealWorldScenarios:
    """Test realistic use cases from the issue report."""

    def test_file_listing_with_japanese_names(self):
        """Realistic file listing as reported in the issue."""
        rows = [
            ["レポート_2024.pdf", "12", "2024-11-02"],
            ["notes.txt", "3", "2024-11-20"],
            ["議事録.docx", "48", "2024-10-15"],
        ]
        result = render(rows, ["name", "KB", "modified"])
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Should have 5 lines: header, separator, 3 data rows
        assert len(lines) == 5
        # All data rows should have same number of columns
        for line in lines[2:]:
            assert line.count("|") == 2  # 2 pipes for 3 columns

    def test_separator_line_with_japanese(self):
        """Separator line should align with Japanese content."""
        rows = [
            ["レポート", "12"],
            ["file", "34"],
        ]
        result = render(rows, ["name", "KB"])
        lines = result.split("\n")
        separator = lines[1]
        # Separator should contain proper alignment
        assert "-+-" in separator or ("-" in separator and "+" in separator)

    def test_visual_alignment_property(self):
        """All rows should have pipes at same visual position when displayed."""
        rows = [
            ["レポート", "12"],
            ["notes", "345"],
        ]
        result = render(rows)
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Both data rows should have pipe at same character position
        # (This is a property that should hold for correct display width handling)
        pipe_positions_1 = [i for i, c in enumerate(lines[0]) if c == "|"]
        pipe_positions_2 = [i for i, c in enumerate(lines[1]) if c == "|"]
        # Positions might differ slightly due to padding with display width,
        # but structure should be same
        assert len(pipe_positions_1) == len(pipe_positions_2)

    def test_long_name_with_width_limit(self):
        """Long Japanese name with max_width should truncate properly."""
        rows = [
            ["プロジェクトレポート_2024年度_最終版.pdf", "250"],
            ["short.txt", "5"],
        ]
        result = render(rows, ["name", "size"], max_width=20)
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Both rows should have same column count
        for line in lines[2:]:
            assert line.count("|") == 1


class TestEdgeCases:
    """Edge cases with Unicode and Japanese text."""

    def test_empty_cell_with_japanese_header(self):
        """Empty cells shouldn't cause issues with Japanese headers."""
        rows = [
            ["レポート", None],
            [None, "12"],
        ]
        result = render(rows, ["名前", "value"])
        lines = result.split("\n")
        assert len(lines) == 4  # header, separator, 2 data rows

    def test_single_japanese_character(self):
        """Single Japanese character cell."""
        rows = [["字", "a"], ["x", "b"]]
        result = render(rows)
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Should handle single-char case
        assert len(lines) == 2
        assert "|" in lines[0]

    def test_all_japanese_table(self):
        """Table with all Japanese content."""
        rows = [
            ["名前", "年齢"],
            ["太郎", "25"],
            ["花子", "23"],
        ]
        result = render(rows)
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Should render without errors
        assert len(lines) == 5  # 2 data rows + 1 header + 1 separator + 1 extra? 
        # Actually 2 rows + header = 3, +1 separator = 4 total
        assert len(lines) >= 3

    def test_numeric_column_with_japanese_in_other_column(self):
        """Numeric columns should still right-align with Japanese in other column."""
        rows = [
            ["レポート", 12],
            ["file", 345],
        ]
        result = render(rows, ["name", "size"])
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Numeric column should be right-aligned
        # Both rows should have same structure
        assert lines[2].count("|") == lines[3].count("|")

    def test_japanese_with_numbers_mixed(self):
        """Japanese text mixed with numbers in same cell."""
        rows = [
            ["レポート2024", "data"],
            ["file_2023", "info"],
        ]
        result = render(rows)
        lines = result.split("\n")
        assert len(lines) == 2
        assert "|" in lines[0]


class TestConsistency:
    """Test that rendering is consistent across different scenarios."""

    def test_same_content_same_output(self):
        """Rendering same content twice should produce same output."""
        rows = [["レポート", "12"]]
        result1 = render(rows)
        result2 = render(rows)
        assert result1 == result2

    def test_width_calculation_consistency(self):
        """Column width should be calculated consistently."""
        # Wide character (2 width) + ASCII (1 width)
        rows1 = [["字abc", "x"]]  # 字 (width 2) + a, b, c (width 1 each) = 5 display width
        rows2 = [["abcde", "x"]]  # a, b, c, d, e (width 1 each) = 5 character count
        
        result1 = render(rows1)
        result2 = render(rows2)
        # Both should have similar column structure
        assert result1.count("|") == result2.count("|")

    def test_header_width_matches_content_width(self):
        """Header column width should match content width when using display width."""
        rows = [["レポート"]]
        result = render(rows, ["name"])
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Header line and data line should have same column structure
        assert lines[0].count("|") == lines[2].count("|")

import pytest
from tablefmt import render


class TestJapaneseBasicAlignment:
    """Test that columns align correctly with Japanese text."""

    def test_japanese_in_first_column(self):
        """Japanese in first column should not shift other columns."""
        # レポート has display width of 8 (each Japanese char is 2 columns)
        # notes has display width of 5
        # Both should align within the same column width
        result = render(
            [["notes"], ["レポート"]],
            ["name"]
        )
        lines = result.split('\n')
        # All lines should have the same visible column positions for separators
        # The separator should be at the same position across all rows
        assert len(lines) == 3  # header, separator, 2 data rows
        # Find position of the first | separator in each line
        sep_positions = [line.find('|') for line in lines]
        # All separators should be at the same position (accounting for display width, not char count)
        assert sep_positions[0] == sep_positions[1] == sep_positions[2]

    def test_japanese_in_multiple_columns(self):
        """Multiple columns with Japanese text should align independently."""
        result = render(
            [["notes", "small"], ["レポート", "small"]],
            ["name", "desc"]
        )
        lines = result.split('\n')
        # Find the two separator positions in the header line
        header = lines[1]  # separator line
        sep_positions = [i for i, c in enumerate(header) if c == '+']
        
        # All subsequent lines should have separators at the same positions
        for line in lines[2:]:  # Skip header and separator
            line_seps = [i for i, c in enumerate(line) if c == '|']
            # The position should correspond to the separator in the header
            assert len(line_seps) == len(sep_positions)

    def test_reported_issue_example(self):
        """Test the exact example from the issue report."""
        result = render(
            [
                ["レポート_2024.pdf", 12, "2024-11-02"],
                ["notes.txt", 3, "2024-11-20"],
                ["議事録.docx", 48, "2024-10-15"],
            ],
            ["name", "KB", "modified"]
        )
        lines = result.split('\n')
        
        # Verify structure
        assert len(lines) == 5  # header, separator, 3 data rows
        
        # All lines should have separators at consistent positions
        separator_line = lines[1]
        separator_positions = [i for i, c in enumerate(separator_line) if c == '+']
        
        # Every data line should have | at positions corresponding to the + in the separator
        for line in lines[2:]:  # Skip header and separator
            pipe_positions = [i for i, c in enumerate(line) if c == '|']
            assert len(pipe_positions) == len(separator_positions)


class TestJapaneseAlignment:
    """Test column width calculations with Japanese characters."""

    def test_all_separators_align(self):
        """All separator characters should be in vertical alignment."""
        result = render(
            [
                ["日本", "10"],
                ["x", "2000"],
                ["テスト", "5"],
            ],
            ["name", "value"]
        )
        lines = result.split('\n')
        
        # Extract separator positions from the rule line
        rule_line = lines[1]
        # Find all + positions (column separators in the rule)
        plus_positions = [i for i, c in enumerate(rule_line) if c == '+']
        
        # For each data line, pipes should align with + positions
        for data_line in lines[2:]:
            pipe_positions = [i for i, c in enumerate(data_line) if c == '|']
            # Should have same number of separators
            assert len(pipe_positions) == len(plus_positions)
            # Positions should match (± maybe 1 for different char widths, but should be exact)
            assert pipe_positions == plus_positions


class TestJapaneseTruncation:
    """Test that truncation works correctly with Japanese text."""

    def test_truncate_japanese_text(self):
        """Truncation should account for display width of Japanese characters."""
        # max_width must be respected in display columns, not character count
        result = render(
            [["レポート_2024_presentation.pdf"]],
            max_width=10
        )
        lines = result.split('\n')
        # The text should not exceed max_width display columns
        content = lines[0]
        # Count display width: Japanese chars are 2, ASCII is 1
        # Should end with … (ellipsis)
        assert "…" in content

    def test_truncate_mixed_content(self):
        """Truncation with mixed ASCII and Japanese."""
        result = render(
            [["ファイル_name_123456789"]],
            max_width=12
        )
        lines = result.split('\n')
        # Should truncate and add ellipsis
        assert "…" in lines[0]

    def test_truncate_respects_max_width(self):
        """Truncated output should not exceed max_width in display columns."""
        # Create content that's definitely wider than max_width
        result = render(
            [["レポート_長いファイル名_2024.pdf"]],
            max_width=15
        )
        lines = result.split('\n')
        # The result should fit within constraints
        assert len(lines) > 0


class TestJapaneseWrapping:
    """Test that wrapping works correctly with Japanese text."""

    def test_wrap_japanese_text(self):
        """Wrapping should handle Japanese characters correctly."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート_2024_presentation_summary"]],
            max_width=10,
            wrap=True
        )
        lines = result.split('\n')
        # Should have multiple lines due to wrapping
        assert len(lines) > 1

    def test_wrap_respects_max_width(self):
        """Each wrapped line should respect max_width in display columns."""
        result = render(
            [["ファイル_長いファイル名_2024_プレゼンテーション"]],
            max_width=12,
            wrap=True
        )
        lines = result.split('\n')
        # Should have multiple lines
        assert len(lines) > 1


class TestJapaneseAlignment:
    """Test alignment with Japanese text."""

    def test_left_align_japanese(self):
        """Left-aligned Japanese text should pad on the right."""
        result = render(
            [["a"], ["レポート"]],
            align="left"
        )
        lines = result.split('\n')
        # Both rows should have the same length (accounting for display width)
        # The shorter line should have trailing spaces
        assert len(lines[0]) == len(lines[1])

    def test_right_align_japanese(self):
        """Right-aligned Japanese text should pad on the left."""
        result = render(
            [["a"], ["レポート"]],
            align="right"
        )
        lines = result.split('\n')
        # Both rows should have the same length
        assert len(lines[0]) == len(lines[1])

    def test_center_align_japanese(self):
        """Center-aligned Japanese text should pad on both sides."""
        result = render(
            [["a"], ["レポート"]],
            align="center"
        )
        lines = result.split('\n')
        # Both rows should have the same length
        assert len(lines[0]) == len(lines[1])


class TestJapaneseMixedContent:
    """Test rendering with mixed ASCII and Japanese content."""

    def test_mixed_rows(self):
        """Rows with both ASCII and Japanese should align properly."""
        result = render(
            [
                ["notes.txt", "small"],
                ["レポート.pdf", "large"],
                ["doc", "tiny"],
            ],
            ["name", "size"]

        # All data lines should have pipes at matching positions
        for line in lines[2:]:
            pipes = [i for i, c in enumerate(line) if c == '|']

    def test_mixed_with_numbers(self):

        result = render(
            [
                ["file.txt", 100],
                ["ファイル.pdf", 50],
            ],
            ["name", "size"]
        )
        lines = result.split('\n')

        plus_positions = [i for i, c in enumerate(separator) if c == '+']
        
        for line in lines[2:]:
            pipes = [i for i, c in enumerate(line) if c == '|']
            assert len(pipes) == len(plus_positions)


class TestJapaneseEdgeCases:
    """Test edge cases with Japanese and wide characters."""

    def test_only_japanese(self):
        """Table with only Japanese text."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート"], ["文書"], ["ファイル"]],
            ["名前"]
        )
        lines = result.split('\n')

    def test_none_cells_with_japanese(self):

        )

    def test_single_japanese_char(self):

class TestJapaneseWithMaxWidth:
    """Test max_width parameter with Japanese text."""

    def test_max_width_with_japanese_in_narrow_column(self):
        """max_width should limit display width, not character count."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート_長い_ファイル名"]],
            max_width=8
        )
        lines = result.split('\n')
        # Should be truncated or wrapped
        assert len(lines) > 0

        )
        # Should fit without truncation

    def test_wrap_with_narrow_max_width_and_japanese(self):

        result = render(
            [["レポート_data_2024"]],
            max_width=6,
            wrap=True
        )
        lines = result.split('\n')
        # Should wrap into multiple lines
        assert len(lines) >= 2

import pytest
from tablefmt import render


class TestJapaneseCharacters:
    """Test that Japanese and other East Asian characters align columns correctly."""

    def test_japanese_in_first_column(self):
        """Japanese characters in a cell should not shift subsequent columns."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート_2024.pdf", 12, "2024-11-02"], ["notes.txt", 3, "2024-11-20"], ["議事録.docx", 48, "2024-10-15"]],
            ["name", "KB", "modified"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # All lines with separators should align (separators in same column)
        # Find the position of the first pipe in each data row
        pipes_col = [line.find("|") for line in lines if "|" in line]
        # All pipe positions should be the same (all in same column)
        assert len(set(pipes_col)) == 1, f"Pipe positions not aligned: {pipes_col}"
        # Second pipe should also align
        second_pipes = [line.find("|", line.find("|") + 1) for line in lines if line.count("|") >= 2]
        assert len(set(second_pipes)) == 1, f"Second pipe positions not aligned: {second_pipes}"

    def test_simple_japanese_cell(self):
        """A single Japanese cell should be rendered correctly."""
        result = render([["日本"]], ["name"])
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Check that separator line is properly sized for the Japanese text
        # 日本 is 2 chars but 4 visual columns, so separator should be at least 4 dashes
        sep_line = lines[1]
        # Should have dashes proportional to the width
        assert "-" in sep_line
        # Should have proper formatting
        assert "|" in result or "-" in result

    def test_japanese_mixed_with_ascii(self):
        """Columns should align when mixing Japanese and ASCII in the same column."""
        result = render(
            [["日本", "data1"], ["notes", "data2"]],
            ["name", "value"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Find pipe positions across all lines
        pipes = [line.find("|") for line in lines if "|" in line]
        # All pipe positions should match
        assert len(set(pipes)) == 1, f"Pipes not aligned in mixed Japanese/ASCII: {pipes}"

    def test_wide_character_alignment_multiple_rows(self):
        """Multiple rows with Japanese text should maintain column alignment."""
        result = render(
            [
                ["レポート", 12],
                ["notes", 3],
                ["議事録", 48],
            ],
            ["file", "KB"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Verify that pipe separator is in same column for all rows
        pipe_positions = [line.find("|") for line in lines if "|" in line]
        assert len(set(pipe_positions)) == 1, f"Column separator not aligned across rows: {pipe_positions}"

    def test_japanese_with_max_width_truncation(self):
        """Truncation with max_width should handle Japanese characters correctly."""
        # Japanese text that will be truncated
        result = render(
            [["レポート_2024_プレゼンテーション.pdf"]],
            max_width=10,
        )
        # Result should contain truncation ellipsis
        assert "…" in result
        # Result should not crash and should produce reasonable output
        lines = result.split("\n")

    def test_mixed_width_full_scenario(self):
        """Complex scenario with mixed ASCII, Japanese, and multiple columns."""
        result = render(
            [
                ["日本語ファイル.pdf", 256, "2024-11-22"],
                ["notes.txt", 12, "2024-11-20"],
                ["データベース.db", 1024, "2024-11-15"],
            ],
            ["filename", "size", "date"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Verify that all pipes are aligned
        for pipe_index in range(result.count("|") // len(lines)):
            pipe_positions = []
            for line in lines:
                if "|" in line:
                    pos = line.find("|")
                    for _ in range(pipe_index):
                        pos = line.find("|", pos + 1)
                    pipe_positions.append(pos)
            if pipe_positions:
                assert len(set(pipe_positions)) == 1, f"Pipe {pipe_index} not aligned: {pipe_positions}"

        assert len(set(pipes)) == 1, f"Visual width calculation failed: {pipes}"
